items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: That was for Ava Dorfman, there was a senior center in Rome. Yeah she was quite upset.

ctx.x: And it was like oh my God. I said I don’t know, Rick, a drum solo? Oh God I felt so bad.
That was for Ava Dorfman, there was a senior center in Rome. Yeah she was quite upset.
Yeah. I think I ended up going there and doing a make-up or something.
